thread:
Irene: Heads up — canary for the telemetry attribution shim just hit preview and I'm seeing ~0 RouteID on invoice previews for a few tenants. Not all.
Alex: ugh, which canary? the 'route-propagate-v2' one?
Irene: yes. started at 10:13 UTC (canary group B). preview pipeline shows route attr `null` for ~7 tenants.
Sam: pinging logs now. can you paste quick example tenant id?
Irene: tenant=acme-inc. here's the preview event snippet from the ingest consumer logs: ```json
{"event":"invoice_preview","tenant":"acme-inc","route_id":null,"tokens":120} 
```
Kevin: looks like the post-agg join that backfills route_id from enrichment didn't run for those shards. might be an ordering/commit problem with the new kafka partition key.
Sam: I'm seeing commit offsets for that consumer lagging and a lot of duplicates in head-of-line. Could be the key change.
Irene: deploy-bot: canary deploy route-propagate-v2 -> group B (5 hosts) finished at 10:18 UTC :rocket:
ingest-bot: consumer-ingest-1 detected rekeyed topic partitions at 10:16 UTC
Alex: ok we need fast rollback if this impacts billing. How many invoices affected?
Sam: quick query shows ~120 preview events with missing route_id across the last 15m, but real invoice events downstream look OK (so maybe preview enrichment path only).
Kevin: that matches if preview pipeline still reads from shadow topic that wasn't rekeyed. The new shim changed partitioning key to `session_id` from `tenant+session`.
Irene: why did we rekey preview only? I thought we kept routing keys stable.
Alex: the idea was to reduce hot partitions for big tenants, but we missed the shadow fanout compatibility check. my fault.
Sam: quick mitigation: can we rerun enrichment for the affected window? I can trigger a manual replay for shard range 240-247.
Kevin: yes — but watch duplicates. We need idempotent enrichment. Post-agg join script has `--idempotent=true` but preview consumer doesn't dedupe later.
Irene: plan: 1) pause canary group B, 2) trigger manual enrichment replay for last 20m windows on those shards, 3) run preview sanity query, 4) resume after validation. sound ok?
Alex: +1. assign owners?
Irene: I'll pause the canary. Sam will run replay. Kevin will watch consumer offsets and preview query. Alex will coordinate if we need rollback to v1.
Sam: starting replay now: `./enrich_replay --topic=preview-shadow --shards=240-247 --from=2026-03-23T10:00:00Z`
Sam: logs: ``[10:40:11] replay: started shards=240-247``
ingest-bot: replay job 9876 queued, estimate 3m
Sam: replay finished in 2m40s.
Kevin: running validation query: `SELECT count(*) FROM previews WHERE route_id IS NULL AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'` -> result 3 (down from 120)
Irene: ok that 3 are probably unrelated older tombstones. Preview lookups for acme-inc show route_id restored.
Alex: great. Any followup to prevent reoccurrence?
Kevin: revert partitioning change in preview shim until we add compatibility layer for shadow topics. Also add an automated check in the rollout job: if rekeying is part of the change, block canary unless `shadow-compat=true`.
Sam: + add an alert to console that triggers when preview vs invoice route_id mismatch ratio > 0.5% for 10m.
Irene: I'll file a followup ticket with RFC: "preview shadow partitioning compatibility" and include the replay playbook. assigning to Alex/Kevin/Sam.
Alex: thanks. also let's add a small e2e test that ingests a fanout session and verifies route attr survives both v1/v2 keys.
Irene: resolved for now. marking canary paused and owners on the ticket. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: canary group B paused for route-propagate-v2 at 10:45 UTC
Alex: nice work everyone, reassigning to postmortem in #postmortems if needed.
